selectionAggregation.independentUnit: one scenario instance identified by family, variant, and seed
selectionAggregation.pairwiseFamily: compute each variant separately, then arithmetic-mean the four variant estimates
selectionAggregation.otherFamilies: compute the family estimate directly from its scenario instances
selectionAggregation.macro: arithmetic mean of the four equally weighted family estimates
selectionAggregation.nullPolicy: do not impute; a null criterion ranks after every finite value; if all retained values are null, skip that criterion
selectionAggregation.invalidPolicy: a missing, malformed, non-finite, discontinuous, failed, duplicated, or provenance-mismatched run invalidates its candidate for that phase

selectionRule: rank macro success descending and retain values within 0.01 absolute of the best
minimize macro pre-correction overlap exposure and retain within max(5 percent of best overlap exposure, 1e-6)
minimize macro maximum pre-correction agent penetration and retain within max(5 percent of best penetration, 1e-4 meters)
minimize macro median normalized travel time conditional on success and retain within 1 percent of the best finite value
resolve remaining ties by canonical method key in lexicographic order

testEstimators.pathRatio: median of non-null run-level arithmetic means of per-agent (1 / pathEfficiency), equal to path length divided by straight-line distance

pairing: exact scenario SHA-256 and scenario identity
forbidden: post-correction safety as the primary collision measure
imputation of unavailable conditional travel time
